Specification: This module specifies the client-side state and actions of a session-based messaging system. It models clients that can open a session with a server, close an existing session, issue command requests while a session is active, and process server responses for those operations. The module tracks per-client session identifiers and a client-side command counter, and it relies on externally defined messaging actions such as Send and Discard from extended modules rather than defining a complete temporal specification here.
RecordConstructor:
[mtype    |-> CloseSessionRequest,
             msession |-> client[c].id,
             msource  |-> c,
             mdest    |-> s]

[mtype |-> CommandRequest,
             msession |-> client[c].id,
             mcommand |-> clientCommand,
             msource |-> c,
             mdest |-> s]
